selection_origin: Implementation-team literature inspection and source recovery; neither owner-supplied complete answer nor autonomous scientific discovery.

sources.finding: Interventional information is underused; methods and held-out cell evaluation are already supplied. Target selection is explicitly an existing research direction, not a novel class supplied by this lab.
Existing Bayesian experimental design selects intervention targets and values in nonlinear SCMs. Its in-silico results are not real Norman evidence.
Existing max-flow and matroid framework constructs identifiable perturbation designs. Adaptive selection alone is not an admitted missing means.

Simple linear/additive comparators are essential; the published Norman analysis has 100 single and 124 double perturbations. Performance parity on aggregate expression does not establish rare-interaction discovery.
Matching mean and perturbed mean explain substantial benchmark performance. Perturbation-specific ability requires an endpoint that does not reward generic expression variation.
GEARS already predicts multigene effects and interaction subtypes. Its reported interaction results are a strong competing claim, not evidence that our residual is solved or unsolved.
Challenges conclusions under alternative metric calibration and notes predominance of additive gene-pair effects. This is contrary evidence, not a settled verdict.
Published GlobalFit variant jointly removes energy-generating cycles. Local direction repair is not a whole-model cure.
Displacement/strain-only inverse elasticity can be nonunique. A general optimizer cannot remove missing physical information.
Traction plus displacement can recover moduli under declared nondegeneracy assumptions. Adding a load measurement is established methodology.

sources.kind: primary newer comparative benchmark, identified by paper006
sources.finding: Later broad comparison across27methods29datasets must be considered before any globally strongest or general-superiority claim. Those methods were not all executed in this bounded pilot.

Introduces positive controls and metric calibration across14datasets18metrics. On Norman the additive predictor captures about88% of the ideal gap for well-calibrated metrics; authors discourage sole use of this sparse-combination benchmark. On Wessels23, PRESAGE exceeds additivity on15of18metrics. Calibration and rare-effect evaluation are active prior art, not new discoveries by this lab.

possibilities.beneficiary: Experimental biologists and biotechnology research groups prioritizing combinatorial perturbations.
possibilities.unavailable_outcome: Reliably identify non-additive expression responses in unmeasured gene pairs from limited prior measurements, with calibrated false positives.
strongest_qualified_alternatives: Exact additive response from single-condition means
Regularized linear prediction with matched information and development tuning
possibilities.binding_residual: A high overall-expression score can coexist with inability to distinguish rare interaction-specific responses. Whether the admitted simple complete controls leave a practically useful residual is to be tested.
possibilities.missing_means_hypothesis: A constructed residual representation and acquisition/repair policy can identify rare interactions more reliably at the same information and cost. This is a hypothesis, not prior admission.

transformation.objective_preserved: Predict unseen double-pair expression interactions and reject unsupported claims.
transformation.method_assumption_questioned: Better global transcriptome correlation is a sufficient proxy for useful interaction discovery.
transformation.alternative: Hold out complete double pairs; use control-ranked readouts and calibration-only interaction definition; compare explicit nonadditive residual prediction with complete simple competitors.

possibilities.cheapest_falsifier: On real Norman condition means, compare generated residual operator with additive/matching/linear predictions on verifier-controlled unseen double pairs at the prespecified false-positive threshold. A tie, loss or uncalibrated output rejects advantage.
possibilities.data_route: Pinned published source_data/suppl-qqplot.xlsx; 10,905,627 bytes, Git blob f35c9efe3bf0f917068b2aaf2c2236b593c06e2c. Its panel is 1000 genes chosen by expression in control, not outcome-selected top differential genes.
limits: Published means omit single-cell and biological replicate variance.
Not the complete Perturb-seq transcriptome or a whole-cell scientific validation.
Real-data pilot, not prospective wet-lab success.
Same gene can recur in many double pairs; uncertainty must respect pair/gene dependence.
Current2026primarystudy recommends Norman not be the sole combinatorial benchmark; richer Wessels23 is an independent successor candidate, not yet qualified.

possibilities.successor_family: Independently selected combinatorial dataset such as Wessels23 with separate gene/context coverage and strong current models; its access and protocol must be independently qualified.

possibilities.unavailable_outcome: Quantify absolute constitutive parameters from passive displacement images without sufficient load/traction information.
possibilities.strongest_complete_alternative: Established inverse elasticity/virtual-field or force-displacement methods with identifiable boundary data.
possibilities.residual: The missing input is physical identifiability, not simply a search weakness. Published load measurements already address standard cases.

possibilities.cheapest_falsifier: Produce indistinguishable displacement observations with different admissible moduli, then ask whether the candidate instrument independently measures the distinguishing quantity.

possibilities.successor_family: Fresh material/geometry calibration with inherited applicability boundaries.

protocol_constraints: Freeze exact source, candidate, tasks, endpoints and practical threshold before protected outcomes.
Do not expose protected AB means to builder before candidate freeze.
Do not derive label thresholds from all evaluation outcomes.
Treat public published threshold-based results as exposed contextual evidence.
Use pair-level uncertainty; do not count every gene-pair row as independent.
Statistical alpha remains zero unless verifier prospectively registers a valid claim procedure.
failure_knowledge: Known local metabolic repair cannot be reused as a whole-model guarantee.
Adaptive causal selection already has strong prior art.
A helper formula mismatch does not establish a paper-result defect when downstream labels use a different path.
A strong older simple baseline does not establish that it is the globally strongest current complete alternative.
Latest primary evidence already supplies positive-control calibration and warns that Norman has near-additive saturation.
